rule: Each question maps to explicitly named open gates. A gate changes only on a written answer that matches a listed outcome; anything else leaves it open. Answers are archived (text + date + sender role) before any gate is changed.

global_rules.if: answer is vague (e.g. 'the data are public', 'you may use our data') without naming the files and the permitted uses
authority confirms normalized factual republication under a named licence or written permission

then.reuse_right: closed if the same statement covers reuse of the files

global_rules.if: original files may not be redistributed

then.effect: normalized factual production may still proceed only if G2 is separately satisfied (variant 1B-B)

global_rules.if: automated retrieval prohibited but manual download permitted

then.effect: production may use archived, owner-downloaded, owner-reviewed inputs (variant 1B-manual)

then.assessment: owner must confirm the Atlas deployment is non-commercial (no paid access, advertising or commercial licensing of outputs); if confirmed, the gate may close as 'restricted_noncommercial_cleared' — never recorded as unrestricted open reuse, and the restriction is shown with the data

global_rules.if: a licence is confirmed only for some years/files

then.effect: gates close per election/file; other elections stay open

global_rules.if: answer refers to a general public-sector-information law without dataset-specific confirmation

then.effect: recorded as context; gates unchanged unless the authority states the files are available for re-use under that law without further conditions

questions.question: Do the CZSO terms (CC BY 4.0) published at csu.gov.cz apply to the Chamber of Deputies election result files published on volby.gov.cz (opendata/psYYYY and appdata/psYYYY/odata)?
questions.insufficient: a link to the general terms without confirming the election files

questions.question: May we download the official XML/CSV/XLSX result packages manually?
May a script retrieve the static final-result packages (low rate, once per election)?
May we publish normalized factual extracts (votes, vote shares, seats, turnout, contestant identifiers) and clearly labelled derived values?
May we redistribute the original files, or only keep them privately for reproducibility?
Is attribution 'Český statistický úřad' with a link to the terms, and labelling derived values as derived, sufficient?

Are the election-result CSV files on volby.statistics.sk/opendata (e.g. NRSR_2016_tab13.csv) covered by the CC BY 4.0 terms of 'Conditions for use and further dissemination of the SO SR statistical information'?

yes.raw_redistribution_right: closed (the terms text itself permits copying and distribution)

questions.insufficient: a general statement that all SO SR data are CC BY without naming the election files or volby.statistics.sk
questions.note: A yes closes raw redistribution only if the reply also confirms no third-party IP exclusion applies to these files.

questions.question: Is manual browser download of final historical CSV files permitted?
Does the robots/spiders prohibition apply to scripted retrieval of a small number of static final files, or is there an approved API/endpoint?

approved_route.automated_acquisition_permission: closed for the named route only

questions.question: Please confirm the attribution (SO SR as source, CC BY 4.0 named, link to the conditions page, no implied endorsement) and how modifications and derived values should be indicated.

conditional.effect: record wording; close attribution_requirements and transformation_disclosure_requirements

questions.question: May the Sejm election result files published on danewyborcze.kbw.gov.pl (2001–2023) be reused, and under which conditions?
questions.insufficient: reference to the general PSI law without stating the files are available for re-use without further conditions (G8)

questions.question: May we publish normalized factual extracts and derived vote/seat shares labelled as derived?
May original files be redistributed, or only archived locally for reproducibility?
Are there conditions on manual or automated download?

conditional.effect: G4 or close both gates as stated

questions.question: Required attribution and transformation disclosure?

Does the Impressum clause ('Übernahme von Beiträgen … unter Quellenangabe … außer für kommerzielle Zwecke') apply to the official Nationalratswahl result workbooks and data files, or is there a more specific licence for election data?
questions.insufficient: confirmation that the pages are public

questions.question: May normalized factual extracts and derived vote/seat shares be published on a non-commercial public research website?
May the original XLS/XLSX/ZIP files be redistributed?
Is manual download by a person permitted (automated AI agents are disallowed by robots.txt)?
Required source attribution wording and indication of changes?
